meta.name: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
meta.description:
A relaxed principal tries to reform a failing public school, triggering a messy transformation as misfit teachers work to repair the system one lesson at a time.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: Illiterate Goldy
videos.overview: Headmaster Gyaneshwar Tripathi can go to the UK if the Class 10 students ace the board exams. The only problem is that the students don't attend school. Meanwhile, the idealistic Kanchan arrives to fix a system that resists change.

videos.title: Ideal Role Model
videos.overview: As Gyaneshwar searches for the perfect role model to motivate clueless students, Kanchan plays detective over a missing confiscated watch.

videos.title: Teacher's Tribute
videos.overview: When teachers demand a water filter, cash-strapped Gyaneshwar must choose between basic facilities and the students' beloved kheer.

videos.title: Dear Daughter
videos.overview: A spelling error gives Purva's award to Purav, sparking a gender revolt that Mukul must handle. Meanwhile, Gyaneshwar chases funds, and Kanchan and Hansraj try to stop a student's marriage.

videos.title: Child Safety
videos.overview: Under Urmila's pressure, Gyaneshwar teaches fake history to influence votes, triggering chaos in class. Meanwhile, Kanchan pushes for Ramesh Kaka's retirement.

videos.title: Candle in the Wind
videos.overview: As Gyaneshwar's UK plan gets revealed to the staff, alumnus Deepak's Olympic gold suddenly puts the school under an unforgiving media spotlight.

videos.title: Trial by Fire
videos.overview: To boost results, Gyaneshwar considers withholding hall tickets of the weak students, risking their future for his dream. Meanwhile, Kanchan refuses to give up on them.
